tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Read the campus or community event programme and consider the teacher's contribution and relevant political science context
Participate in campus and community events through attendance, conversation and the agreed contribution

tasks.design: Keep event preparation and actual participation human. This attendance task specifies no report, record commit or promotional send; a new administrative baseline is not assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation means engaging with people at the actual event.
tasks.enabler_now: No established change removes that work.
tasks.still_hard: Community questions and civic context are situational.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher offers scholarly understanding in a real civic relationship.

ambition.what: No expanded civic or institutional authority.

reach.learn: Clarify whether the teacher is speaking personally or representing the institution.

evidence.claim: Personal event participation requires actual engagement rather than an automatically generated record.

assumptions: Boundary is reading the existing programme and participating, excluding event organisation, registration, travel administration and separately assigned publication. The statement has no required written output or send; confirm any local requirement before adding its baseline.

The organiser supplies actual event, time, place, programme and requested contribution. The teacher reads and clarifies these in s1. No structured capture or extraction is assumed, and missing details are clarified manually.
Illustrative shares are not measured baselines. Existing document access is sufficient; no new tool or configuration is proposed and additional upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether local event participation includes separately required written outputs
research_questions: Is there actual required administration within this task rather than event organisation?

already_counted.description: All preparation and actual participation remain in s1-s2.

incremental.description: No new tool or procedure; zero additional upkeep.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No change to programme reading or personal participation is established. No unstated report or record-writing baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide political science consulting to government or industry

steps.what: Clarify the government or industry client's political science question, intended use, scope and conflicts of interest
Examine political institutions, stakeholder evidence and research methods relevant to the consulting question and develop the substantive advice
Write and check the completed consulting note in {DOCS}; reuse native report headings and reference styles while checking actual recommendations, caveats and the client recipient
Save the exact checked consulting note in {DOCS}
Send the exact versioned consulting note to the checked client through {EMAIL}
Provide professional consulting services by discussing the delivered advice, uncertainties and application with the government or industry client

tasks.design: Test native consulting-note layouts and reference styles in {DOCS}. Keep the political analysis and client discussion human, reduce repeated report formatting, and save and send only the final checked note to the checked recipient.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated report structure and reference formatting consume time after analysis is complete.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reuse format without generating political claims or recommendations.
tasks.still_hard: Client context, causal uncertainty and conflicts of interest need independent judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher explains what the evidence supports and resists an unsupported client conclusion.

ambition.what: No lobbying, electoral targeting or autonomous advice authority.

tasks.altitude: Less report formatting, unchanged responsibility for advice.

reach.learn: Separate descriptive research from a normative recommendation.

evidence.claim: Document templates and reference styles can reduce repeated report formatting without replacing substantive consulting analysis.

assumptions: Boundary is an existing consulting engagement with a short written note and explanation, not procurement of the engagement, government decision-making or political campaigning. Client and other-role time earns no saving.

The client supplies the question, intended use and existing material; the teacher verifies sources, claim references, limitations and actual recommendations in s1-s3. Template fields are title, scope, source reference and section heading, all authored or checked by the teacher. Missing evidence requires manual inquiry; it is not filled by a model.

Native formatting first. Shares are a provisional written-advice scenario, not measured baselines. Ordinary final s3 checking follows completed wording and includes confidentiality and exact client recipient; edits void both save and send checks.
unknowns: Whether consulting notes already use native styles
Whether the institution requires separate engagement or disclosure approval
research_questions: How much repeated formatting remains after native report styles are used?

already_counted.description: Actual note writing and final source and recipient checks remain in s3.

incremental.description: Maintain the consulting-note template and source style.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final consulting note checked in s3; any edit voids approval.
Same note checked in s3 and saved unchanged in s4, to the exact client recipient checked in s3.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Repeated formatting gives 3.45 gross less 0.75 upkeep, or 2.7 net. Existing native styles give zero gain; analysis, client contact, actual wording and save/send effort remain counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Consulting formats can shrink while civic participation and independent scholarly advice remain human.
reach: Work with policy analysts on evidence limitations.
role.ambitious_version: A scholar who gives traceable advice and participates personally in the community.
